name: Monaco Editor Plugin
description: Monaco code editor plugin with multi-tab editing. Bootstrap loads Monaco AMD loader once across all instances via shared monacoReady promise. Defines custom themes (cockpit-dark: base vs-dark, background #0A0E14; cockpit-light: base vs, background #f8f8f8). Multi-tab editing with per-tab cursor/scroll position tracking via savedCursors map. 30+ language detection from file extension. Auto-save debounced 1.5s after content change. Ctrl+S explicit save. External file change detection via fs.onChanged with auto-reload (preserves editor value if matching, closes tab if file deleted). Drag-and-drop tab reorder. Right-click tab context menu (Close, Close Others, Close All, Copy File Path). Sends editor selection state to ide:editorState IPC with 150ms debounce.

dependencies.usage: Tab right-click context menu — renders Close, Close Others, Close All separator, and Copy File Path actions

interface.constructor: (container: HTMLElement) — Creates editor DOM structure (.editor-wrap > .editor-tab-bar > .editor-tab-scroll + .editor-area with unique id monaco-{uuid}), registers file change listener via fs.onChanged, bootstraps shared Monaco AMD loader, initializes empty tab state with 'No file selected' dummy

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Normalizes path (backslashes to forward slashes, lowercases for key), reads file content via IPC fs:readFile, pushes new Tab to tabs array or switches to existing tab, loads content into editor, detects language from file extension, fires onStateChange

methods.name: closeActiveTab
methods.description: Closes the currently active tab via internal closeTab method

methods.name: saveCurrentFile
methods.description: Writes current editor content to file via IPC fs:writeFile, removes active tab from dirtyFiles set, updates dirty CSS indicator

methods.name: updateTheme
methods.description: Reads CSS --bg custom property to detect dark/light mode, applies cocktail-dark or cocktail-light Monaco editor theme accordingly

methods.name: reloadIfOpen
methods.description: If filePath is open in a tab: reads current file content from disk via IPC fs:readFile. If file deleted (content is null), closes tab. If content changed and tab is active, updates editor value preserving dirty flag via suppressDirty mechanism

methods.name: getState
methods.signature: () => { openFiles: string[]; activeFile: string; explorerWidth: number; cursors: Record<string, {lineNumber: number; column: number; scrollTop: number}> } | null
methods.description: Serializes current editor state: original file paths for open tabs, active file path, explorer split width (default 260), and per-file cursor position + scroll top. Returns null if no tabs are open

methods.name: restoreState
methods.signature: (state: { openFiles: string[]; activeFile: string; explorerWidth?: number; cursors: Record<string, {lineNumber: number; column: number; scrollTop: number}> }) => Promise<void>
methods.description: Restores editor state from serialized data: opens all files from openFiles array, switches to activeFile, waits for requestAnimationFrame, then restores per-file cursor positions and scroll offsets

methods.name: getCurrentFile
methods.description: Returns the file path of the active tab (lowercased key), or empty string if no active tab

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns current Monaco editor text content via editor.getValue(), or empty string if editor not initialized

properties.name: tabs
properties.description: Array of open tab objects, each with filePath (lowercased key), name (filename only), and originalPath (full OS path). Displayed in tab bar.

properties.name: activeTab
properties.description: Lowercased file path key of the currently active tab, or null if no tabs are open

properties.name: onStateChange
properties.description: Callback fired when tabs change (open, close, switch, reorder). Set by ExplorerPlugin to trigger workspace state auto-save

features.multi_tab_editing: Multiple files open simultaneously in tabs with per-tab cursor/scroll position tracked in savedCursors map. Active tab switch preserves content and cursor of previous tab
features.auto_save: onDidChangeModelContent event triggers 1.5s debounced auto-save via IPC fs:writeFile, marks tab as dirty during the interval
features.manual_save: Ctrl+S Monaco keybinding triggers immediate saveCurrentFile call
features.language_detection: 30+ file extensions mapped to Monaco language modes (ts→typescript, js→javascript, py→python, rs→rust, etc.). Unrecognized extensions default to plaintext
features.custom_themes: cockpit-dark (base vs-dark, editor background #0A0E14) and cockpit-light (base vs, editor background #f8f8f8) themes defined via monaco.editor.defineTheme
features.file_watch: fs.onChanged listener registered in constructor auto-reloads or closes tabs when files change externally
features.drag_reorder: Tab reordering via HTML5 drag-and-drop (dragstart/dragenter/dragover/dragleave/drop events on .editor-tab elements)
features.tab_context_menu: Right-click on tab shows ContextMenu with Close, Close Others, Close All, separator, and Copy File Path (copies original OS path via IPC clipboard:writeText)
features.middle_click_close: Middle mouse button (button === 1) on a tab closes it
features.editor_selection_state: onDidChangeCursorSelection event debounced 150ms sends ide:editorState IPC notification with active file path, selection range (startLine/startColumn/endLine/endColumn), and selected text

lifecycle.created_by: ExplorerPlugin constructor — one MonacoEditorPlugin instance per Explorer panel for the editor half of the split layout
lifecycle.destroyed_by: ExplorerPlugin card terminate — editor state saved via getState() and restored via restoreState() across sessions
